missingno.note: Ketsuban means “missing number.” In Red and Blue, 36 indices share this form. Its usual cry is nearly silent. It has no evolution or level-up moves.

missingno_ghost.note: Index B8 corresponds to the Ghost form. In the original games, the standard #000 entry could appear on capture if the player had yet to see Cubone.

missingno_wing.note: Index B7 corresponds to the Aerodactyl Fossil form. In the original games, this form could inherit battle data from the last Pokémon whose data was read.

missingno_shell.note: Index B6 corresponds to the Kabutops Fossil form. Later glitches nicknamed MissingNo. are separate from these Generation I forms.

missingno_yellow.note: In Yellow, 36 indices share the standard Yellow form. Its corrupt secondary type can display different names. This record uses the reading 999.
